MICHAEL ONG President Industries Development Corporation (IDC) Dibacong, casiguran Aurora Dear Mr. Ong: 2010 This has reference to your letter dated 29 September 2010, which we received on 08 October 2010, requesting our legal opinion on these issues, to wit: "I) Whether or not there is a need ibr IDC to secure a business permit in the Municipality of • (Aurora) considering that our (IDC's) principal place is located at Casiguran, A uroraP 2) If your answer (in zhe iörego;eg•) be in the affirmative, can the local chief executive can (sic) validly deny our application för a business permit despite {he iict thüt we are operating under a valid and approved IFAIÄ integrated Annual Operations Plan within the municipality and the ihct that the said municipality does not have any existing ordinance/ regulation providing for the requirements in the issuance business permit? S) Upon the submission o/ • the required documents ibr the application of business permit, if • there be any, is the period provided under the law wherein a local government concern may issue a business permit? Per your letter, you said that your company, the Industries Development Corporation (IDC), is a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the Republic of the Philippines with principal place of business at Casiguran, Province of Aurora and that it is operating under a valid and approved Industrial Forest Management Agreement (IFMA) Noo 2001-06 and in accordance to the approved Five-Year Integrated Annual Operations Plan for 2008-2012. You further represented that when IDC applied for a business permit with the Municipality of Dinalungan, the local chief executive (LCE) thereat denied your application and continues to refuse to issue a business permit without however presenting any valid and justifiable reason available under the generally accepted laws. According to you, the LCE's denial is not in accord vvith DILG Opinion No. 15, series of 2009, which stated that without any ordinance prohibiting logging activities, the Municipality of Dinalungan cannot prohibit the same. Hence, your queries.

-2- At the outset, may we just discuss the nature of an Integrated Forest Management Agreement (IFMA). An IFMA is a product:ion sharing contract entered into by and between the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) and a qualified applicant wherein the DENR grants to the latter the exclusive right to develop, manage, protect and utilize a specified area of forest land and forest resources therein for a period of twenty-five (25) years and may be renewed for another twenty-five (25)-year period, consistent with the principle of sustainable development and in accordance with an approved Comprehensive Development and Management Pian (CDMP) and under which both parties share in its produce (DENR Order No. 99-53). Coming now to your first query, please be informed that per our verification with the DENR, said agency is cf the position that if a natural or juridical person was already given a valid and approved IFMA with an approved CDMP and that the aforesaid natural and juridical person has complied with the terms and conditions of the Agreement, such natural or juridical person can already operate logging activities within the local government units (LGUs) mentioned in the IFMA. Though you did not mention in your subject letter these LGUs where IDC can operate logging activities, reference shall be made to the It was previous documents which were submitted to this Department. mentioned in DILG Opinion No. 15, series of 2008 that the IDC was issued a 5- year operation plan under IFMA 2001-06 to operate logging activities within the Municipalities of Dinalungan, Casiguran and Dilasag, which was duly approved by then DENR Secretary Jose L. Atienza, Jr. Such being the case and taking into account the position of DENR per our verification, the IDC itself may validly conduct logging activities within the Municipality of Dinalungan even without a business permit from the said municipality. In view of the foregoing, we find your second and third queries irrelevant. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, JESUS B.
